preprocessing.gene_filter: no highly-variable-gene filter; retain every Gene Expression row in the supplied 10x feature file
preprocessing.normalization: per-cell total-count scaling to 10000 followed by log1p
preprocessing.control_matching: all context-matched single-feature intergenic controls; no additional lane/batch/guide matching

depmap_release.release_citation: DepMap, Broad (2025). DepMap Public 25Q3. Dataset. depmap.org
depmap_release.primary_endpoint_description: Post-Chronos gene dependency probability estimates for all models in the integrated gene effect
depmap_release.secondary_endpoint_description: Post-Chronos gene-effect estimates integrated across screens; copy-number corrected, scaled and screen-quality corrected
depmap_release.chronos_release_specific_change: 25Q3 separated Humagne-CD HiSeq and NovaSeq screen-type batches and changed library-effect regularization to a screen-count-weighted mean gene effect
depmap_release.chronos_version_note: The local CSV and accessed official release metadata do not expose a semantic Chronos package version; report the release/pipeline label without inventing a version.

filter_comparison.statistic: raw mean absolute shift, because low-coverage targets do not have an M1 matched-null object
filter_comparison.filter_off: all endpoint-nonmissing assayed targets with at least one single-feature cell
filter_comparison.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg within filter status across HCC38 and HCC1143

legacy_raw_gate.interpretation: descriptive legacy raw-shift qualification only; external contexts require sampling-aware reassessment before promotion to a revised full audit

chronology.primary_context_designation: selected during benchmark development, not preregistered before observed bridge inspection
chronology.defensible_claim: the revised sampling-aware endpoint object was locked before revised model rescoring
chronology.claim_not_made: the HCC contexts or 25/75 cutoffs were preregistered before all observed-data and model exploration
